verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing is an API-first product: cards, cardholders, authorizations, funding and disputes are all exposed as programmatic API operations, and a community comment confirms the API-first design. An official Stripe CLI is documented, and test mode with simulated purchases supports automated, non-interactive testing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running in CI pipelines (e.g., CI auth or key handling, CLI usage in CI), and independent hands-on reports of headless or CI automation for Issuing specifically.
